verdict.rationale: A probe confirms Fivetran serves a live llms.txt at fivetran.com/llms.txt describing its documentation, and doc pages resolve at agent-friendly .md URLs. Fivetran also ships agent-oriented Connector SDK skills for Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI and Copilot CLI. Missing for 10: the root docs.md index returns 404, there is no evidence of an llms-full.txt or detail on llms.txt coverage, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of agents consuming these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
